incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGE — private connectivity alerts from us-central2 -> us-west1 (customer-facing). Paging oncall.
devon (oncall): picking this up. seeing alerts for BGP flaps and route churn for a handful of customer circuits. assign net-ops. @sara can you eyeball BGP state?
sara (net-ops): on it. initial glance: bgp sessions to provider A in us-central2 are bouncing, routes for prefix 10.90.0.0/16 are alternating between privatepath and public fallback via transit. Looks like AS path rewrite on provider side. grabbing logs.
cloud-provider-bot: Provider A reported maintenance event in us-west1 zone affecting qpeer-7. Related BGP resets: 6 events in last 10m.
devon (oncall): customer impacted = AcmeCorp (VIPs: 10.90.12.0/24). They reported intermittent failures in API calls ~15m ago. Tanya from Acme pinged support.
anya (customer-success): confirmed, Acme is seeing 502s and TCP resets. They want ETA. I'll tell them we're investigating and will update every 15m.
sara (net-ops): dumping BGP summary:
```
# show bgp summary | include 10.90
Peer 10.2.3.5     AS 64512  State: Established  Prefixes: 120
Peer 10.2.3.6     AS 64512  State: Idle        Prefixes: 0
Peer 10.2.3.7     AS 64513  State: Established  Prefixes: 118 (oscillating)
```
sara (net-ops): traceroute from our egress to 10.90.12.11:
```
1  10.1.1.1  1.1 ms
2  100.64.0.2  3.2 ms
3  203.0.113.9  25 ms  <-- provider A
4  198.51.100.5  *   *  (flapping)
5  10.90.12.11  40 ms
```
sara (net-ops): logs show rapid BGP update/withdraw from provider A, then a fallback to transit. suspect provider-side aggregation or route-reflector misconfig.
devon (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) lock routes to prefer privatepath via local-preference temporarily, 2) request provider A to stop flapping or move to stable session, 3) if instability persists, fail traffic to Dedicated transit for affected customers.
sara (net-ops): implementing temporary local-pref bump for Acme prefixes. applying route-map on edge-routers now.
```
configure terminal
route-map PREF-ACME permit 10
 set local-preference 200
match ip address prefix-list ACME
exit
```
sara (net-ops): applied. advertising updated routes. monitoring BGP for 2 mins.
devon (oncall): @cloud-provider-bot open ticket with Provider A, include our BGP logs and observed AS path changes. request timeline and whether they ran config changes.
cloud-provider-bot: Ticket opened: PA-234567. Provider acknowledges, currently investigating config churn on RR cluster in us-west1.
anya (customer-success): told Acme: 'we've put a temporary preference to keep your traffic on private paths; provider engaged.' They're appreciative but asked for root cause.
devon (oncall): good. watch for recurrence. if we see more than 3 withdraws in 10m, we'll escalate to failover to transit and kick off customer failover playbook.
sara (net-ops): update: provider says an automated config push to RR pool incorrectly redistributed internal-only routes causing path selection flips. They're rolling back in us-west1 now.
sara (net-ops): seeing BGP stabilized — last 10m no withdraws for Acme prefixes. latency normalizing.
mike (oncall-next): chime-in: I'm next on shift in ~25m. what should I monitor handoff checklist?
devon (oncall): handoff notes for @mike: 1) watch BGP session state to provider A (10.2.3.5-7) 2) confirm no more withdrawals for prefixes 10.90.0.0/16 3) keep Acme updated every 30m until incident closed 4) escalate if withdraws >3 in 10m.
mike (oncall-next): ack. I'll take over in 25m and keep eyes on the ticket.
anya (customer-success): Acme asked about postmortem. I'll coordinate with net-ops for RCA and timeline.
sara (net-ops): followups to create: - RFC for route preference fallback on customer prefixes - automation to detect provider RR config pushes that affect customer routes - a runbook update to include explicit provider ticket template.
devon (oncall): recording incident classification: Private Connect provider-induced BGP instability causing customer-visible API errors. Severity: S2 (partial outage for single customer).
incident-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-2489076543. Responders: devon (oncall), sara (net-ops). Status: monitoring.
sara (net-ops): closing update: provider rollback verified, BGP stable, Acme reporting normal traffic. I'll create a draft RCA in #postmortems and link provider ticket.
anya (customer-success): sending final customer update: 'private path stability restored; we will share RCA and mitigations by EOD.'
devon (oncall): handing off to @mike now. if anything spikes, page oncall. closing live incident channel in 30m unless we get regressions.
mike (oncall-next): took handoff at 2489077289. ack — monitoring. will file follow-up tasks.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (monitoring phase) — closed at 2489077289. Postmortem required.
